agentAbility.name: Electro Vision
agentAbility.description: Activate an electromagnetic scanning field to make every enemy within a 500m radius Traced for you for a short time.

agentTrait.name: Overpenetration
agentTrait.description: After penetrating the first target, your shells continue flying with reduced damage and penetration until it hits a second target within a certain distance.

tankAbilities.name: Hypercharge
tankAbilities.description: Charge the gun with a surge of energy to boost your shot's penetration and reduce reload time.

tankAbilities.name: Energy APS
tankAbilities.description: Activate a 360 degree APS that intercepts incoming shells. Shells that are intercepted consume the vehicle's energy.
